preconditions.description: The number of clues n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of existing direct links m is between 0 and 10^5 inclusive.
The modulo divisor k is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct clues within the valid range [1, n].
The number of provided edges matches m.

preconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(sorted(e)) for e in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: No duplicate edges exist in the input.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer strictly less than k.
The output equals the number of ways to add exactly T edges to make the graph connected, modulo k, where T is the minimum number of edges required to connect all components.
